name: Top Winners and Losers
query:
SELECT
  cph.security AS "Security:Link/CF Security:140",
  cs.security_name AS "Security Name:Data:180",
  cph.allocation_percentage AS "Allocation %%:Percent:120",
  cph.current_value AS "Current Value:Currency:130",
  cph.profit_loss AS "P/L:Currency:120",
  cph.profit_loss_percentage AS "P/L %%:Percent:110",
  cs.suggestion_action AS "Recommendation:Data:120"
FROM `tabCF Portfolio Holding` cph
LEFT JOIN `tabCF Security` cs ON cs.name = cph.security
WHERE cph.portfolio = %(portfolio)s
ORDER BY cph.profit_loss_percentage DESC, cph.profit_loss DESC, cs.security_name ASC;
